notes: Studio: the tablet can transcribe a piano recording into a playable piece and compose new piano pieces by itself, both running on the tablet with no cloud service. Piano › Studio downloads the two models once (125 MB and 173 MB). Transcribe a recording… takes any audio the tablet plays; Compose a piece… takes a mood, key, tempo, length and a piece from your library to write in the manner of. Each result asks Keep or Discard after your first listen. Also: the app keeps its other device architectures, the security audit's hardening, and a denser composing budget.
